rationale: Although OKTA has nudged slightly above the $197.71 session VWAP, the bounce is occurring on low 1-minute volume and remains capped below the descending 5-minute 9-EMA ($200.18) and our $199.50 invalidation level. Moreover, the bid-ask spread is exceptionally wide at $1.14 (57.4 bps), so closing at market now would force an immediate buy at the $199.09 ask and forfeit almost the entire remaining risk buffer without confirming a true structural breakout. Holding allows the position to work within its original parameters while avoiding severe spread slippage.
